description: DS3-enabled dispatch leaves routing results unassigned outside the single-group configuration.
trigger: Set deepseekv3_routing=True with n_group or topk_group different from 1, including default None values.
expected_behavior: Perform grouped routing or explicitly reject the unsupported configuration.
actual_behavior: The routing_ds3 call is commented out. selected_experts remains unbound when consumed by either expert-mask construction or fused GEMM. Built-in constructors do not enable this flag, limiting established reach to the new API.

verification.description: Traced dispatch assignments and inspected both located constructors.
verification.limits: Conditional API path; no repository execution.
